description: We are frequently having to restart the DAD every week, the reason being that patients are not intrerfacing with symphony once messages are sent to the DAD. Once restarted the messages come through.
close_notes:
Hello Adrian,
 
I'm pleased to let you know that we've found a resolution for your case CS1644865.
 
To resolve this:

We have checked the Symphonydad.log file and Windows Event Viewer again for 11/09/26 and there is nothing of any relevance recorded.
We have also checked message processing for that day and there appears no actual interruption in the flow of the PMI Inbound patient data) message processing.

As we advised previously, you continue to use the Symphony.exe Application version of the DAD Interface.
This can sometimes appear to fail where there are network issues locally (this has been previously the case within CHI), or where there is any period of inactivity from the PAS end of the interface the DAD can appear to 'trip'.
The Application version can be sensitive to the performance and status of the DAD server and how long it has been running since last  rebooted and Windows updates applied.  We recommend this be done every month or 2at least.

There are no signs of any specific connection rejections for 11/05/25.
We are throughout assuming that you are logging onto the DAD server using the account  HEALTHIRL\CHISymphonyDAD and are starting the interface using the  account SYMPHONYDAD.
If  using another account may well cause issues with processing.

In either case. before restating the DAD it is always advised that you first ensure it is stopped. This can be checked and achieved via Task Manager, ending the task FWDADServWkr.exe (if running) followed by SymponDAD.exe.
Then restart the DAD.

If you are using an Integration Engine (TIE) between the Symphony end of the interface and the PAS end, we would advise having that checked, as we at Optum do not support it and possibly monitored in case this is causing issues with Interface performance or connectivity. Likewise your local Network generally.

Overall, we would suggest if this situation is ongoing that you raise a request for us to scope, configure and enable the Windows Service version of the DAD interface to take over from the Application version.
The Service tends to be more robust and less likely to fail.

I hope this helps.

Many thanks


 
We're confident this will fully address the issue. However, if you find that the problem persists, simply click the red 'Reject Solution' button and we'll be happy to investigate further.
 
Kind regards,
Konrad
